tasks.subject: Lock product scope, architecture, fallback, and verification contract
Add the actor skin contract and promote the vendored Kenney POC textures
Integrate URL selection and scene-lifetime actor presentation ownership
Add focused unit and browser automation for presentation and lifecycle
Run full gates and close the delivery state

acceptanceMap.A1: Product-owner approval and an interface-first three-layer architecture are recorded before implementation.
acceptanceMap.A2: The Phaser-independent contract represents two skins, two teams, five animation states, eight directions, source metadata, explicit fallback, and weapon-layer policy.
acceptanceMap.A3: The two POC runtime textures exist, trace to vendored Kenney CC0 sources, and add no network or purchase dependency.
acceptanceMap.A4: Missing, legacy, or invalid URL selection preserves Ground Shaker bodies and external weapons; kenney-infantry swaps deterministic team textures and hides external weapons.
acceptanceMap.A5: One scene-lifetime controller owns body and weapon presentation, team swaps, effects, transforms, debug state, and idempotent shutdown while gameplay and collision stay unchanged.
acceptanceMap.A6: Focused unit and browser tests cover fallback, teams, states, directions, asset existence, weather, scene shutdown plus page restart cleanup, screenshots, and console errors.
acceptanceMap.A7: Static, full unit, build, full browser, MainScene LOC, status, reviewer, drift, and postflight gates pass for the current fingerprint.
